ruleset.name: under-test advice
ruleset.description: Advice: rules whose findings are reported, by the pmdAdvice task, but don't fail the build. See AGENTS.md.

rule.name: PreferStreamsToForEachLoops
rule.message: Prefer a stream, or forEach, to a for-each loop
rule.description: A for-each loop over a collection or array often reads better as a stream or a forEach call. Reported, not failing the build: a loop whose body throws a checked exception, returns early or breaks may be clearer as it is.
